units.source_text: 黑稳健地下47，接着白占领下边的星位大场，这时候，在旁观战的我不禁吓了一跳。

en.t: Black calmly played move 47; then White occupied the large star-point area on the lower side. At that moment, watching from the sidelines, I could not help being startled.

units.source_text: 倒不是说我从黑47这一手感受到大竹七段的棋风，而是似乎觉得七段已经悟到在此面临决一胜负的形势。

en.t: It was not that I sensed Otake 7-dan's style in Black 47; rather, it seemed to me that he had already realized this was the position where the game would be decided.

units.source_text: 他让白爬在第三线，自己却牢固地筑起一道直到黑47为止的厚墙。

en.t: He let White crawl along the third line, while he himself firmly built a thick wall extending as far as Black 47.

units.source_text: 从这里可以看出大竹七段浑身充满了力量。

en.t: From this, one could see that Otake 7-dan was filled with strength throughout his whole body.

units.source_text: 七段稳扎稳打，采用了绝不输棋和绝不中对手圈套的着法。

en.t: The 7-dan played steadily and solidly, choosing moves that would neither lose the game nor fall into his opponent's trap.
